long_biography.plain_text:
At 18, Hopp chose sports management when his father placed Adler Mannheim in his hands. He helped steer the ice-hockey club after its 1998 financial rescue and became its managing shareholder. Hopp also took a central role in creating the SAP Arena, opened in 2005 as the club’s new home and a venue for concerts and other sports.

Beyond the arena, he manages holdings through DAH Beteiligungs. His controlled companies have held substantial stakes in technology businesses, while later activity has extended into renewable energy and professional padel. The combination of a family-derived capital base and direct operating roles has made him both an investor and a long-term sports administrator in the Rhine-Neckar region.
